headline: Carhenge / Shandoka goes before HARC Meeting on Wednesday, November 18
blurb: A heavy agenda for November 18. The two items that have been waiting since August — the Shandoka Lot redevelopment preliminary large-scale reviews for Buildings 1 & 2 and Buildings 3 & 4 at 860 Black Bear Rd — are finally being heard, with the Town of Telluride as applicant and Design Workshop doing the design work. Both involve new construction outside the historic district exceeding 5,000 sq ft in an Accommodations 2 zone.
